chunks.title: Team permissions catalogue (company application)
chunks.heading: Permission groups and actions
chunks.text:
Company team members are given permissions per group; a permission is "<group>.<action>". Groups and actions:
- Gigs [gigs]: view (Voir), create (Créer), edit (Modifier), delete (Supprimer), activate (Activer / pause)
- Prospects [leads]: view (Voir), import (Importer), create (Créer), edit (Modifier), archive (Archiver), export (Exporter)
- Téléphonie [telephony]: view (Voir), search (Rechercher), buy (Acheter), assign (Affecter), terminate (Résilier), test (Appel test)
- Scripts [scripts]: view (Voir), create (Créer), edit (Modifier), delete (Supprimer)
- Base de connaissances [knowledge]: view (Voir), create (Ajouter), edit (Modifier), delete (Supprimer)
- Matching / REPs [matching]: view (Voir), invite (Inviter), decide (Accepter / refuser)
- Formation [training]: view (Voir), create (Créer), edit (Modifier), delete (Supprimer)
- Appels [calls]: view (Voir), listen (Écouter), validate (Valider), export (Exporter)
- Tableau de bord [dashboard]: view (Voir)
- Agents [agents]: view (Voir), create (Créer), edit (Modifier), remove (Retirer)
- Planification [planning]: view (Voir), create (Créer), edit (Modifier), delete (Supprimer)
- E-mails [emails]: view (Voir), create (Créer), send (Envoyer)
- Assistant vocal [voice]: view (Voir), edit (Configurer)
- Activation des gigs [activation]: view (Voir), edit (Modifier)
- Qualité [quality]: view (Voir), review (Contrôler)
- Opérations [operations]: view (Voir)
- Analytique [analytics]: view (Voir)
- Portefeuille [wallet]: view (Voir), deposit (Déposer), withdraw (Retirer)
- Abonnement [subscription]: view (Voir), change (Changer de plan)
- Tokens et facturation [billing]: view (Voir), buy (Acheter)
- Équipe [members]: view (Voir), invite (Inviter), edit (Modifier les droits), remove (Retirer)
- Réglages [settings]: view (Voir), edit (Modifier)

Presets excerpt:
PRESET_IDS = ['admin', 'operator', 'readonly'] as const;
export type PresetId = (typeof PRESET_IDS)[number] | 'custom' | 'owner';

const OPERATOR = [
  'gigs.view', 'gigs.create', 'gigs.edit', 'gigs.activate',
  'leads.view', 'leads.import', 'leads.create', 'leads.edit',
  'telephony.view', 'telephony.search', 'telephony.assign', 'telephony.test',
  'scripts.view', 'scripts.create', 'scripts.edit',
  'knowledge.view', 'knowledge.create', 'knowledge.edit',
  'matching.view',
  'training.view',
  'calls.view', 'calls.listen', 'calls.validate',
  'billing.view',
  'settings.view',
];

export function allPermissionKeys(): string[] {
  return PERMISSION_GROUPS.flatMap((group) => group.actions.map((action) => `${group.id}.${action.id}`));
}

export function emptyPermissions(): PermissionMap {
  return Object.fromEntries(allPermissionKeys().map((key) => [key, false]));
}
